raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in Step 2 by accepting and acting upon incorrect information provided by the WebSurfer. The WebSurfer's initial search results (visible in the viewport) did not explicitly state that Muhammad Ali won the most BBC Sports Personality of the Year awards; rather, they showed a list of links and a general description of the award. The Planner incorrectly inferred that "Most wins: Muhammad Ali (3)" was a definitive fact found on the page, leading to a complete derailment of the task. This error caused the conversation to pursue the wrong subject (Muhammad Ali) for several steps, ignoring the actual record holder (Andy Murray) who was eventually identified in later steps. The Planner failed to critically verify the source content before updating the "Updated Understanding" and issuing new instructions based on false premises.
